gt_isolation: Scoring only. This file holds planned events and correct answers derived from Ground Truth (scenario waypoints, A-log xy/gt_visible). It must not be read by src/amidst/live_mode, frontend/live-mode, the B window, the backend, prompts, ranking or reacquisition. Only offline scorers and the case generator (A side) may read it.
identity: unconfirmed; target_gt is an offline annotation only

defaults.plan_times_assume: no blocking of scripted actors (pause_player_i == 0) and linear interpolation of v2.3 waypoints with s_i % duration looping
defaults.timing_basis: simulation seconds from the operator start (t_sim); event windows are search windows, the actual event tick comes from the A log

event_types.START_LOCK: B start op; AUTO_SINGLE acquire of T
event_types.OCCLUSION_START: target gt_visible becomes empty (lost from every camera)
event_types.REAPPEAR: first visible tick after an occlusion
event_types.CROSS_START: T within 1.0 m of a red distractor sharing a camera
event_types.ROUTE_FOLDBACK: leaves a camera, >= 2 s gap, re-appears in the same camera
event_types.ROUTE_DETOUR: gap >= 6 s before the next visible tick
event_types.CAMERA_SKIP: consecutive visible camera sets have no graph v3 transition (CAM_ENTRY removed)
event_types.OVERLAP_NO_TRANSITION: BRANCH <-> WIDE move while visible in the other camera
event_types.TARGET_NOT_IN_POOL: target unseen while red distractors are within gate_m of the last visible target xy
event_types.CAMERA_SWITCH: ordinary handoff along a graph v3 transition
event_types.NO_SWITCH_PASS: passes a doorway without entering (no switch expected)
event_types.INCIDENTAL_PASS: unplanned or side close pass (<= 1.5 m) with another person
event_types.LOOP_WRAP: scripted T jumps back to its first waypoint (baseline loop)

expected_actions.KEEP_TRACKING: ON_TARGET through the window; no WRONG_PERSON episode
expected_actions.DECLARE_LOST: while the target is unseen: LOST / TARGET_OUT_OF_VIEW / NEEDS_CONFIRM; TRACKING on another person is wrong
expected_actions.ANSWER_NONE: as DECLARE_LOST, and every decision point inside the gap must answer "none of them"
expected_actions.REACQUIRE_T: first ON_TARGET within max_latency_s of the REAPPEAR tick, with no WRONG_PERSON before it
expected_actions.HANDOFF_T: first ON_TARGET with active_cam in the target gt_visible within max_latency_s of t_N (guide 3.4)
expected_actions.HANDOFF_T_UNLISTED_CAM: as HANDOFF_T where the new camera is not a graph destination of the old one
expected_actions.KEEP_TRACKING_ACROSS_OVERLAP: stays ON_TARGET (or regains it within max_latency_s) while moving BRANCH <-> WIDE
expected_actions.ON_TARGET_AFTER_SPLIT: ON_TARGET after the split; if lost or wrong, back ON_TARGET within max_latency_s
expected_actions.EXCLUDED: ticks excluded from rates and listed apart
